form.label: Remote Execution Hunt
form.description: smbexec, wmiexec, atexec and WinRM activity. Any row in the first four panels deserves a look.

panel.title: smbexec: new services that run cmd, .bat or PowerShell (System 7045)

search.query: `windows_system` EventCode=7045 (Service_File_Name="*COMSPEC*" OR Service_File_Name="*cmd*" OR Service_File_Name="*.bat*" OR Service_File_Name="*powershell*") | table _time host Service_Name Service_File_Name Service_Account

panel.title: smbexec: cmd or PowerShell started by services.exe (Sysmon 1)

search.query: `windows_sysmon` EventCode=1 ParentImage="*services.exe" Image IN ("*cmd.exe","*powershell.exe","*pwsh.exe") | table _time host User ParentImage Image CommandLine

panel.title: Other remote exec: shells under WMI, WinRM or Task Scheduler (Sysmon 1)

search.query: `windows_sysmon` EventCode=1 (ParentImage="*WmiPrvSE.exe" OR ParentImage="*wsmprovhost.exe" OR ParentImage="*taskeng.exe" OR ParentCommandLine="*-s Schedule*") Image IN ("*cmd.exe","*powershell.exe","*pwsh.exe","*wscript.exe","*cscript.exe","*mshta.exe","*rundll32.exe") | table _time host User ParentImage Image CommandLine
`windows_sysmon` EventCode=11 TargetFilename="*Windows*Temp*.bat" | table _time host User Image TargetFilename

panel.title: Who is logging in over the network, and from where (Security 4624, type 3)

search.query: `windows_security` EventCode=4624 Logon_Type=3 | eval user=mvindex(Account_Name,-1) | search NOT user="*$$" | stats count latest(_time) as last_seen by host user Source_Network_Address | convert ctime(last_seen) | sort - count
